description: Read a diagram from a Diagrammo Cloud space, by `id` or by `title` in `folder`. Titles match case-insensitively. Returns JSON `{ id, title, folder, chartType, version, updatedAt, source }`. Needs DGMO_API_KEY (a space API key) in the server environment. Errors when the key is refused (401/403) or nothing matches (404); list_space_diagrams shows what is there.

folder.description: Folder path from the space root, e.g. "docs/architecture". Omit for the root.

id.description: Diagram id. Takes precedence over title.

space_id.description: The space the API key belongs to (the key does not name it).

title.description: Diagram title, when no id is given.

name: get_space_diagram
